## Type of change

<!-- Check exactly one. -->

- [ ] **Editorial** — typos, formatting, broken links; no change in meaning
- [ ] **Informative** — docs, examples, diagrams, rationale; no normative change
- [ ] **Normative (draft)** — changes requirements in a `Draft` PP document
- [ ] **Status transition** — moves a PP document between statuses (see `pp/README.md` and GOVERNANCE.md)

## Checklist

<!-- Mirrors the Pull Request Checklist in CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] Issue reference included (except trivial editorial fixes)
- [ ] Normative/informative language audited — BCP 14 keywords (MUST, SHOULD, MAY…) in capitals only where a requirement is meant
- [ ] Requirement IDs (`[PP-NNNN-RQ-KKK]`) added/updated as needed; **none renumbered or reused**
- [ ] Schemas under `schemas/` and examples under `examples/` updated together; examples validate against the schemas
- [ ] `reference/glossary.md` and `reference/object-model.md` updated if terms or kinds changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under *Unreleased* for normative changes
